_documentation.model_purpose: Point-in-Time Real Expected Value (EV) and Dual Confluence Matrix for quality_swing Tide Model
_documentation.return_formula: Real Return = (Price(t_pivot_next) / Close(t)) - 1. Zero Ghost Return bias.
_documentation.horizon_gate: Maximum horizon = 120 days. Eliminates truncated or missing future swings.

state_hierarchy.L3: Full 3D State: T_slope|C_slope|vwap_sigma_wave (180 granular micro/macro states)
state_hierarchy.L2: Mid-Macro State: T_slope|C_slope (36 mid-term trend states)
state_hierarchy.L1: Macro State: T_slope (6 macro tide trend states)
state_hierarchy.L0: Global Baseline: Aggregated market baseline across all observations

vwap_sigma_wave_position.<<: FLOOR — Price far below VWAP Wave (sigma_vwap < -1.0 std dev)
vwap_sigma_wave_position.<: BELOW — Price moderately below VWAP Wave (-1.0 <= sigma_vwap < -0.30)
vwap_sigma_wave_position.~: NEUTRAL — Price near VWAP Wave center (-0.30 <= sigma_vwap <= +0.30)
vwap_sigma_wave_position.>: ABOVE — Price moderately above VWAP Wave (+0.30 < sigma_vwap <= +1.0)
vwap_sigma_wave_position.>>: CEILING — Price far above VWAP Wave (sigma_vwap > +1.0 std dev)

field_glossary.n: Sample size for this state/level combination
field_glossary.is_rare_state: Flag booleano de muestra baja (N < 30) preservado para eventos de cola
field_glossary.p_bull: P(next pivot = MAX). Probability of ceiling/top opportunity
field_glossary.p_bear: P(next pivot = MIN). Probability of floor/bottom opportunity
field_glossary.ev_net: Real Expected Value: P(bull)*E[ret_max] + P(bear)*E[ret_min] - friction_bps
field_glossary.e_ret_min: Expected real drawdown % to next MIN pivot
field_glossary.e_ret_max: Expected real upside gain % to next MAX pivot
field_glossary.sharpe: Real EV / std(real_return). Risk-adjusted return ratio
field_glossary.e_days: Expected calendar days to next pivot
field_glossary.ev_per_day: Real return speed per calendar day

_documentation.signal_interpretation_policy: Clean Architecture Standard: Tactical actions are dynamically evaluated in runtime by pure-domain adapters. Dynamic rules: P(bull) >= 0.55 and EV >= +0.005 -> ACCUMULATE; P(bull) >= 0.52 and EV >= +0.002 -> BUY_DIP; P(bull) <= 0.45 or EV <= -0.005 -> TRIM; Else -> NEUTRAL.
_documentation.rare_event_policy: States with extreme deviation (vwap_sigma_wave = << or >>) represent mean-reversion spring stretch. Samples n >= 1 are preserved without artificial fallback degradation to maintain tail asymmetry.
